question: The Ilbert Bill was passed during the term of Lord Ripon to bring Indian and European magistracy on equal footing in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1883.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Ilbert Bill **was passed in **1883** during the term of Lord Ripon.
